messages:
incident-bot: P1 - model preload failures in eu-west cluster. Automatic page triggered for service=redwood-serving, model=rwkv-7b-v2, symptom=OOM+deserialization errors during preload. Impact: increased 502s for hosted endpoints. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/model-load-failures>. Paging: @olivia (oncall)

olivia: On it, grabbing handoff. Can someone drop the first logs and which pods are failing?

julia: seeing repeated failures from runtime pod group 'serve-eu-1'. Paste from journalctl:
```
[2026-03-14T09:12:23Z] ERROR serving.runtime: failed to preload model rwkv-7b-v2: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory
[2026-03-14T09:12:23Z] ERROR model.loader: deserialization error: unexpected EOF while reading shard 2
[2026-03-14T09:12:53Z] WARN compiler: kernel compile timeout (30000ms) for attention_kv_fused, aborting
```

raj: two things stand out: 1) shard partial write / artifact truncated -> deserialization EOF, 2) later fallback attempt triggers JIT compile timeout and OOM. Possible artifact corruption + large batch / prewarm footprint.

sam: support telemetry shows ~1.2k failed requests in last 15m, top impacted customers: acme-inc (280 errors), beta-app (120). Error code surface: 502 Gateway, runtime 503 in logs. Customers alerted?

olivia: @sam not yet, hold until mitigation validated. Primary mitigation plan: 1) route traffic away from rwkv-7b-v2 to a healthy fallback (rwkv-7b-q4) 2) disable model preloading (preload=false) on eu-west pool to avoid repeated OOMs 3) reduce max_batch_size and JIT compile timeout temporarily. Who can flip routing?

eng-oncall: I can handle routing. Starting canary reroute to rwkv-7b-q4 for 10% traffic now. Command: ```curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/route -d '{"model":"rwkv-7b-q4","fraction":0.1,"pool":"eu-west"}'```

ops-bot: autoscaler event: Node pool eu-west-1 scaled +2 nodes in last 5m (policy: recover).

julia: rolling through runtime config for eu-west: setting `PRELOAD_MODE=false`, `MAX_BATCH_SIZE=8`, `COMPILE_TIMEOUT_MS=60000`. Applying to configmap and triggering rollout: ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/serve-runtime-eu-west```

raj: also verify artifact integrity. Running `sha256sum` on shards in s3 mirror and comparing to registry. If shard truncated, we should pull a fresh build.

julia: artifact check in progress. Quick grep shows shard-2 size 0 on one replica mount -> likely S3 partial sync on that node. Fetching clean copy and will replace mount.

olivia: while julia does that, eng-oncall can you increase fallback fraction to 50%? We need error volume down before notifying customers.

eng-oncall: increasing to 50% now. ```curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/route -d '{"model":"rwkv-7b-q4","fraction":0.5,"pool":"eu-west"}'```  Response: 200 OK.

sam: error rate dropping from 502s: 1.2k -> 420 in 5m window. Notifying affected tier-1 customers with initial status: investigating, mitigation in progress.

julia: replaced corrupted shard with fresh copy from registry on pod serve-eu-1-a. Restarted container. New preload log shows: ```INFO model.loader: checksum ok for shard-2; proceeding
INFO model.loader: completed preload in 12.3s
```

julia: but note - on one host we still saw `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` during a retry attempt, likely because previous OOM left GPU in bad state. Rebooting node eu-west-node-12 now.

ops-bot: node eu-west-node-12 cordoned and draining. Reboot job started.

raj: after replacing artifact and lowering batch, recommend we keep fallback routing at least 20% for 10m while we monitor. Also push a hotfix: mark artifact as immutable and enforce shard size checks during deploy to prevent partial-syncs. Creating PR now.

eng-oncall: lowering fallback to 25% and setting canary healthchecks. ```curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/route -d '{"model":"rwkv-7b-q4","fraction":0.25,"pool":"eu-west"}'```

sam: customer impact update: error count down to 140 in last 5m; acme-inc reported degraded latency but no data loss. Sending follow-up note.

olivia: good. I'll keep incident declared P1 until metrics stabilize <1% error. Who can verify compile timeouts are resolved?

julia: compile scheduler no longer logging timeouts after reducing concurrency. Patch applied: `COMPILE_TIMEOUT_MS=60000` and worker concurrency reduced to 2. Logs: `INFO compiler: compile completed for attention_kv_fused in 45ms`

ops-bot: node reboot complete; node rejoined. GPU health OK.

incident-bot: Timeline note: initial page 09:12Z, routing mitigation 09:20Z, artifact replace 09:28Z, node reboot 09:35Z, error rate <1% at 09:50Z.

raj: PR for artifact validation created: <https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5489>. If merged, will fail deploy on shard size mismatch.

olivia: marking mitigation steps as complete. Leaving fallback at 10% for 30m then remove if stable. Preparing postmortem checklist: - root cause: partial shard sync -> deserialization EOF -> repeated preloads -> OOM + compile timeouts -> node instability. - mitigations taken: routing fallback, disable preload, reduce batch & compile timeout, replace corrupted shard, node reboot.

sam: draft customer status updated and sent. Customers on P1 list notified of fix and ETA for full rollback.

eng-oncall: rolling back fallback to 10% now. ```curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/route -d '{"model":"rwkv-7b-q4","fraction":0.1,"pool":"eu-west"}'```

julia: monitoring: cumulative error rate 0.4% last 10m, latency stable.

olivia: downgrading incident severity to P2 in 30m if no regressions. Great work everyone. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident closed to active response. Add postmortem when ready and tag with labels: [model-load, artifact-corruption, fallback-routing, eu-west].
